content: coder/websocket v1.8.15 (2026-06-15): zero-dep, autobahn-passing RFC 6455 impl; context-first API; concurrent writes safe; SetReadLimit default 32KB (ErrMessageTooBig + status 1009); OriginPatterns allowlist (denies cross-origin by default); RFC-compliant Close. gorilla/websocket v1.5.3 (2024-06-14): un-archived but near-dormant (last push 2025-03, 78 open issues); websocket.org guide (updated 2026-03) recommends coder/websocket for new projects.
